data.title: NZ military chief resigns over ‘inappropriate relationship’
data.description: WELLINGTON - The head of New Zealand’s military has resigned over an “inappropriate relationship” he had while in charge of a unit, the Defence Force said on Friday.

data.title: Typhoon forces Thai Airways to cancel Taiwan flights
data.description: Thai Airways International suspends all flights to and from Taiwan on Friday as Typhoon Champi approaches the island.

data.title: Man U skipper Carrick already on borrowed time
data.description: MANCHESTER, England - Beset by infighting and off to their worst league start for decades, Manchester United host Bournemouth needing to snap a seven-game winless run to quell talk of another mid-season managerial change.

data.title: PP pushes reforms to Thai PBS funding
data.description: The main opposition People's Party (PP) will propose amendments to public broadcasting law alongside a bill introduced by the ruling Bhumjaithai Party (BJT), seeking to protect Thai PBS's editorial independence while strengthening accountability.

data.title: Customs proposes scrap metal, rubber import ban
data.description: The Customs Department has proposed banning scrap metal and rubber imports to prevent hazardous waste and electronic scrap from being smuggled into Thailand, citing environmental pollution and risks to public health.

data.title: PISA gains mask poor basic skills
data.description: Thai students improved their performance in science, mathematics, and reading in the Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA) 2025, but nearly 60% failed to reach basic proficiency levels in mathematics and reading.

data.title: Online mental health clinics to be set up in schools
data.description: The government will pilot online mental health clinics in 100 schools to help students, teachers and education staff access early psychiatric care and reduce risks that could lead to violence on campus.

data.title: BMA to unleash inspectors
data.description: Bangkok will launch its "environmental inspectors" policy across all 50 districts on Nov 1 to strengthen pollution control through joint inspections, standardised checks and year-round monitoring of major pollution sources.

data.title: Buriram ace Bissoli bags month's gong
data.description: Buriram United striker Guilherme Bissoli was named Thai League 1 player of the month for September, while Rayong's Akkraporn Chalittaporn won the coach of the month award.

data.title: DSI to review case over ballot QR codes
data.description: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) will examine a complaint against eight people accused of trying to decode ballot codes in a Bangkok by-election, according to the justice minister.

data.title: Army denies  targeting Preah Vihear
data.description: The Royal Thai Army has rejected Cambodia's claim that Thai attacks damaged Preah Vihear temple, accusing Cambodian forces of using the World Heritage site as a military base.

data.title: Dressed to kill: Haircuts cap menacing look of Japan's yakuza
data.description: TOKYO - At a barbershop in Tokyo, yakuza gangster Tekisasu glances in the mirror at his meticulous new cut and thanks the hairdresser for the weekly trim crucial to his mobster trade.

data.title: Taiwan shuts down ahead of Typhoon Champi, hundreds of flights cancelled
data.description: YILAN, Taiwan - Almost all of Taiwan shut down on Friday ahead of the arrival of Typhoon Champi, which is forecast to bring strong winds and torrential rain, and though the storm is weakening it could still make direct landfall on the island.

data.title: Police raid 3 suspected scam hubs
data.description: Immigration police have arrested 14 people in raids on three Bangkok properties suspected of housing a scam and online gambling network linked to losses of more than 100 million baht.

data.title: PM ramps up drug crackdown
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered authorities to intensify efforts to dismantle transnational drug trafficking networks and target production sources before the narcotics reach Thailand.

data.title: New York votes to ban Central Park horse carriages after decades of debate
data.description: NEW YORK - New York's city council on Thursday voted to ban horse-drawn carriages in Central Park, signalling the end of a tourist ritual that's been subject to years of heated debate.

data.title: Earthquake of magnitude 7 strikes China's Tibet, killing 16
data.description: An earthquake ofmagnitude 7 struck China's southwestern region of ​Tibet at around 10.33pm (9.33pm Thailand time) on Thursday, killing 16 people and injuring 32 others, state news agency Xinhua reported,

data.title: Bournemouth hammer 10-man Milan, Juventus denied at the death
data.description: PARIS - Bournemouth pulled off a sensational 3-0 home victory over 10-man AC Milan on Thursday to make it three wins from their opening three games in the Europa League.

data.title: Your daily horoscope for Oct 23

data.title: Don't take the bait
data.description: Not to be confused with Trap, a thriller starring Josh Hartnett that is also streaming on Netflix, The Trap is a German psychological thriller miniseries based on Melanie Raabe's bestselling novel Die Falle. Unfortunately, despite its intriguing premise, this is one trap viewers might want to avoid falling into.

data.title: Jazz up your wrist with Breitling  Navitimer Tribute to Miles Davis
data.description: The centennial of Miles Davis's birth in 2026 has Breitling paying homage to the American musician and style icon through a limited edition inspired by the Navitimer Reference 806 Mk5 from the mid-1960s.

data.title: Pushing the limits
data.description: Longines recently opened a new chapter of the Master Collection in a big way with six ambassadors gathering for the Home Of Elegance campaign.

data.title: Catch BTS in Argentina this weekend at SF, Major cinemas across Thailand
data.description: Tickets for the BTS World Tour "Arirang" In Bangkok concerts on Dec 3, 5 and 6 sold out almost immediately when they went on sale.

data.title: Stars shine in pool and on road
data.description: Thai para athletes made a big splash in the Aichi-Nagoya pool and burned rubber on the road to add two more gold medals to the Thai haul at the 2026 Asian Para Games on Thursday.

data.title: Thai players face uphill battle against Switzerland
data.description: Thailand will face a formidable test against Switzerland in the 2026 Billie Jean King Cup Playoff World Group tie next month.

data.title: PP chief urges unity after chat leak
data.description: Opposition People's Party (PP) leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut has dismissed reports of internal divisions following leaked messages from the party's MPs' LINE group.

data.title: SX 2026 expo shifts towards resilience
data.description: The Sustainability Expo (SX 2026) will return to Bangkok from Nov 6-15, focusing on helping people adapt to a changing world by shifting attention from climate change mitigation to building resilience against its growing impacts.

data.title: Udon Thani plant expo 'ready to open'
data.description: The Udon Thani International Horticultural Expo 2026 is ready to welcome visitors from Nov 1, with 20,000–30,000 expected daily.

data.title: Suphajee to stay, says PM
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has vowed to keep Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun in his cabinet amid rumours of an impending reshuffle, describing her as a "key pillar" of his administration.

data.title: Thousands rally as Serbia heads to pivotal poll
data.description: BELGRADE - Tens of thousands of supporters of Serbia's opposition student movement gathered in central Belgrade on Thursday, as the country's longtime leader Aleksandar Vucic rallied across town at the duelling final events ahead of pivotal parliamentary elections.

data.title: Monet's 'Iris' fetches 50 mn euros at Paris auction
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - "Iris," a monumental painting by Impressionist Claude Monet, sold for 50 million euros ($56 million) including buyer fees in Paris on Thursday, becoming the most expensive artwork ever sold at auction in France.

data.title: Africa faces 'complex' Ebola outbreak after spread to Nigeria: WHO
data.description: LAGOS - The World Health Organization warned Thursday that Africa faced a "complex" Ebola outbreak after the virus crossed from east Africa to Nigeria, marking the first case in the west of the continent.

data.title: ‘NAZA’ documents how mass killings become a nine-to-five
data.description: How do you know a film is important? Not because it received a 25-minute ovation at its Venice premiere, but because the Israeli government threatened to revoke its directors’ citizenship over the documentary.

data.title: UN climate disaster fund moves to provide $20m aid for Nepal
data.description: WASHINGTON - The United Nations' (UN) climate loss and damage fund moved Thursday to provide US$20 million in aid sought by flood-stricken Nepal, the first time it has set aside money for any country, in a key test of the body's credibility.

data.title: Pentagon, Lockheed announce agreement for 850 F-35 jets over 10 years
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The Pentagon and Lockheed Martin on Thursday announced a 10-year agreement for the production of 850 F-35 warplanes, underscoring Washington's long-term commitment to the high-tech stealth aircraft.

data.title: American detained in Russia arrives in US: lawyer
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - A retired US teacher freed by President Vladimir Putin after four years' detention in Russia for allegedly fighting on behalf of Ukraine has returned to the United States, his lawyer said Thursday.

data.title: French authorities seek to ban or curb fresh protests
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - French authorities on Thursday imposed bans and restrictions aimed at fresh protests springing up in the wake of demonstrations last weekend that degenerated into the worst street violence in years.
